request.text: Thank you to everyone who visited our booth. We enjoyed meeting the community and hearing your questions.
Our combat-proven drones are deployed in military operations. We guarantee 100% accuracy. Text in image 1: autonomous battlefield deployment
We signed three survey contracts. The work brings this year's transportation portfolio to eight projects.

sources.text: The company signed three survey contracts. Its transportation portfolio now includes eight projects this year.
